nodes.label: Statistical Analysis and Modeling of the 3D Morphology and Texture of Lunar Regolith Simulants
nodes.description: The paper uses 3D X-ray micro-CT data and multivariate statistical/parametric modeling to quantify size and shape descriptor distributions for lunar regolith particles and seven mare/highlands simulants, finding large morphological differences among simulants and versus lunar regolith and motivating improved simulants or statistically representative digital models for simulation-based studies of morphology-driven mechanical behavior relevant to ISRU. (regolith.pdf p.1, p.2)
